allOf.$comment: turn_ext_server is unusable without the secret that signs its credentials. Settings.vue already refuses that pair, so this guards the direct API callers it cannot reach. Only the explicit clear is catchable here: an omitted turn_ext_secret means 'keep the stored one', which the schema cannot see, so 15turn_secret warns about that case at run time.

host.description: Host name for the application, like 'bbb.domain.org'

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate.

public_address.title: Public IP address
public_address.description: The address WebRTC clients use to reach this node. It is announced by mediasoup, not bound locally, so a NAT address is correct here. Detected at install time; override when a port-forward uses a different address.

private_address.title: LAN IP address
private_address.description: Optional. When set, mediasoup also advertises this address so clients on the local network connect directly instead of relying on NAT reflection.

stun_server.title: STUN server
stun_server.description: Optional, like 'stun:stun.example.org:3478'. Empty by default: this module ships no coturn, and a public STUN server would receive every participant's IP address.

turn_ext_server.title: External TURN server
turn_ext_server.description: Optional, like 'turns:turn.example.org:443?transport=tcp'. Without it, clients behind UDP-blocking firewalls cannot join. Needs turn_ext_secret to be usable.

turn_ext_secret.title: External TURN shared secret
turn_ext_secret.description: The TURN server's static-auth-secret, which BigBlueButton uses to sign each client's time-limited credentials. The only authentication mode it supports, so a TURN server without it is never reached. Omit the field to keep the stored value, send an empty string to clear it: it is never returned by get-configuration.

enable_recording.title: Enable recording
enable_recording.description: Record meetings. Recordings capture everything that happens in the conference: obtain participants' consent.

enable_external_videos.title: Allow sharing an external video
enable_external_videos.description: A moderator can play a YouTube or media URL in sync for everyone. The server relays nothing, but every participant's browser fetches it from the third party.

enable_breakout_rooms.title: Allow breakout rooms
enable_breakout_rooms.description: Each breakout room is a full meeting of its own, with its own audio conference and media transports, so a split multiplies what the node carries.

learning_dashboard_max_age_days.title: Learning dashboard retention (days)
learning_dashboard_max_age_days.description: How long a meeting's report stays readable after it ends. 0 keeps it forever. Enforced by the maintenance job, which runs every 30 minutes, because bbb-web's own timer does not survive a restart.

enable_learning_dashboard.title: Enable learning dashboard
enable_learning_dashboard.description: Let moderators open the learning analytics dashboard, which reports each participant's connection time, talking time, chat messages, raised emojis and poll answers. Access is by shared link rather than by role, so disable it where that activity data must not leave the moderators.

sounds_language.title: Sound announcements language
sounds_language.$comment: Keep in sync with SOUNDS_LANGUAGES in ui/src/views/Settings.vue: a code listed only there is rejected on save, one listed only here is never offered.

disable_sound_alone.title: Disable alone announcement
disable_sound_alone.description: Suppress the "You are the only person in this conference" announcement

welcome_message.title: Welcome message
welcome_message.description: Replaces the default welcome message shown in the chat

welcome_footer.title: Welcome footer
welcome_footer.description: Replaces the default welcome footer shown in the chat

remove_old_recording.title: Delete old recordings
remove_old_recording.description: Let the periodic maintenance job delete recordings past their retention. Requires recording to be enabled.

recording_max_age_days.title: Recording retention (days)
recording_max_age_days.description: Recordings older than this are deleted, provided deletion is enabled.
